capabilities: track local third-party plugin usage over time
show a searchable overview of installed plugins with last-used and 7-day totals
summarize plugin update status and link to the official update page
keep daily usage history with configurable retention
clear or pause all collected statistics
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states all statistics stay local in the vault and no telemetry is sent; some passive plugins cannot be measured reliably.
problem: Obsidian gives no visibility into which installed community plugins you actually use over time, so unused ones are hard to identify and disable.
summary: Usage tracker that records how often you use third-party community plugins and shows the statistics in one local overview.
